simple.summary: יִדּוֹ (Yiddôw) means Jiddo , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 27 21.

definitions.full: H3035. Yiddo יִדּוֺ proper name, masculine 1. a Manassite , 1Chr 27:21 , ᵐ5 Ιαδδαι . 2 one of those who took foreign wives Ezra 10:43 Kt (Qr יַדַּי ; compare Palmyrene ידי = dilectus Vog No. 5 ), ᵐ5 Δια , A Ιαδει , ᵐ5 L Ιαδιαι . יַדַּי proper name, masculine see יִדּוֺ .
